description: External long-term global 1deg daily ELSE_GPCC runoff
data_source: ELSE_GPCC runoff product associated with Kim et al. (2009)
access_notes: External source data; source files are not tracked in Git or included in repository/distribution packages. Only Roff.ctl metadata is tracked. No direct download URL or separate license terms are recorded in inspected files.
distribution_scope: External data; not included in source repository or distribution package
notes: Tracked CTL declares global 360x180 1-degree, little-endian, yrev, undef=-999 and mm/day. Local source contains 11,688 expected-size daily files from 1979-01-01 through 2010-12-31 plus a zero-byte 2011-01-01 file, conflicting with CTL tdef 7671 starting 1981-01-01. Recheck actual files before runs. Provenance is maintainer-confirmed; citation is not evidence of redistribution permission or scientific validation.

data_source: ELSE_GPCC runoff product (Kim et al., 2009); two-year test subset from inp/ELSE_GPCC/Roff/
access_notes: Available only in the separate CaMa-Flood v4.30 distribution package
notes: The package CTL says tdef=1000 while 731 daily files are present; use actual file coverage, not the CTL record count. gosh/test1-glb_15min.sh configures IFRQ_INP=24 and DROFUNIT=86400000. Dataset values have not been scientifically validated. The maintainer confirms that this package sample is a two-year test extraction from the long-term global 1-degree ELSE_GPCC/Roff product; the source product is not Git-tracked here.

data_source: ELSE_GPCC runoff product (Kim et al., 2009); regional subset extracted by inp/test-mek_1deg/s01-extract_ELSE_GPCC.sh
access_notes: Original global ELSE_GPCC data remain external and are excluded from Git and distribution packages. The complete regional sample is tracked in the GitHub repository and included in the distribution package.
distribution_scope: repository-tracked sample; distribution package included; redistribution approved by maintainer
notes: Maintainer-selected domain 90-110E, 5-35N matches map/mekong_15min; source rows are NtoS and source values are copied as little-endian float32 without unit conversion. CTL undef=-999. Output grid and dates are validated by the extraction helper. This is format/provenance validation, not scientific validation.

description: Japan hourly 6min runoff, aggregated from TE-japan 1min sample
data_source: Today's Japan 1-arcmin simulation output (Yoshimura Laboratory), spatially aggregated to 6 arcmin for CaMa-Flood
access_notes: Derived from the existing test_jpn_1hr sample. Original Today's Japan simulation output provided by Yoshimura Laboratory; redistribution permission obtained. Reproduce using inp/test-jpn_6min_1hr/s01-aggregate_runoff.sh.
distribution_scope: repository-tracked compact sample; redistribution permission confirmed by maintainer
notes: 6x6 latitude-dependent spherical-area-weighted spatial mean; original hourly values and temporal order retained without unit conversion. The maintainer identifies the original source CTL mm/day label as erroneous and assesses the values as mm/hour, consistent with gosh/test3; this physical interpretation was not independently verified. Source blocks containing any -9999 are output as -9999; inspected source has no missing cells. Technical conservation and format checks do not independently validate source runoff science.

description: ERA5-Land Japan sample in CaMa-Flood NetCDF format
access_notes: Repository-tracked converted sample. The conversion workflow requires the raw ERA5-Land source; account and terms apply to new downloads. See inp/ERA5-Land_download/ReadMe.md.
notes: File metadata declares units=mm, 24-hour accumulated depth, time=31 daily labels, and fill value 1e20. The unit conversion yields DROFUNIT=86400000. description: ERA5-Land Japan sample in daily-file binary format
access_notes: The CTL and report are tracked; binary files are ignored by Git. The maintainer reports recalculating the sample with the 24-hour wrapper; observed output is 31 daily files with one grid per file, matching the tracked 31-time NetCDF and CTL.
distribution_scope: Git metadata tracked; local binary records ignored and untracked
notes: The regenerated output has 31 records at 24-hour spacing, matching the 31 daily input timestamps and current wrapper setting. The previous two-record files were an interim local state; their historical origin is not verified. No scientific validation of the runoff values was performed.

description: Two-day sample global ERA5-Land runoff NetCDF for direct input
data_source: ERA5-Land global runoff downloaded from the Copernicus Climate Data Store
access_notes: Local format-check sample only; ignored by Git. Re-download through inp/ERA5-Land_download/t01-download-global.sh after configuring the requested period. Requires a matching 3600x1801 runoff input matrix and a NetCDF-enabled model build.
distribution_scope: External CDS source; sample not tracked or distributed
notes: Downloaded on 2026-11-02 using the configured CDS API, 24-hour timestep, global domain. Observed NetCDF: ro(valid_time,latitude,longitude), float32, units=m, GRIB_stepType=accum, _FillValue=NaN; 2 time records, 1801 decreasing latitude values 90 to -90, 3600 longitude values -180 to 179.9 at 0.1 degree. Source structure matches the model NetCDF reader when CVNTIME=valid_time and CVNROF=ro. DROFUNIT=86400 is the dimensional conversion for m per 24-hour record, conditional on the source accumulation interpretation. This check does not validate runoff science or first/last accumulation attribution.

description: Mekong annual 1-degree NetCDF runoff sample converted from test-mek_1deg
access_notes: Derived from the maintainer-approved, repository-tracked Mekong regional sample; original global ELSE_GPCC source data remain external.
distribution_scope: Intended as a compact GitHub-tracked sample; future v5 package inclusion awaits a v5 packaging workflow.
notes: Use CROFFREQ=YEAR with CROFDIR/CROFPRE/CROFSUF; Git tracks runoff2000.nc through runoff2005.nc; 366 records in 2000 and 2004, 365 in other listed years; variable runoff(time, latitude, longitude), float32, CF proleptic_gregorian daily time with bounds, longitude centers 90.5..109.5E and descending latitude centers 34.5..5.5N, missing value -999. The original 2000-2001 sample had an exact float32 conversion round-trip check; this documentation update does not claim a numerical recheck of the expanded current file set. See adjacent README. Format verification is not scientific validation.
